cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Comfort Everyone Else
cards.instruction: Meet every painful moment by comforting someone else more intensely while your own distress becomes harder to hide.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've made you soup. The choir rejecting us doesn't mean you should miss dinner. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You've set a bowl for yourself too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. So you won't have to eat alone. I'll butter your bread.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Sit with me. I don't want you crying in the kitchen.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right. But take my bread too. I can't swallow yet, and you shouldn't have to ask twice.

mechanism: A directs dinner after shared rejection, reframes A own place as service to B and concedes sitting while giving away more comfort as A distress surfaces.
confusable: Unlike ordinary hospitality alone, each B observation exposes A pain and prompts greater care for B; projected control survives by accepting the seating request.
comparison: Meal service and inability to swallow differ from a tissue box and shaking after layoffs.
seedUse: D117-b soup, own bowl and bread; S02-a adapts the service plan to B request without relinquishing the caregiver frame.
